newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kinnard starts Polaris.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kinnard starts Polaris.

text.p: John G. Kinnard & Co analyst Saul Yaari said he initiated coverage of Polaris Industries Inc with an accumulate rating.
Polaris makes snowmobiles, all-terrain vehicles and personal watercraft.
Yaari said he expects Polaris to show improvement in the 1997 second half after a slow first six months.
He estimates 1997 second quarter earnings at $0.47 a share, down from $0.58 a year earlier. He estimates third quarter earnings at $0.80, up from $0.57 a year ago.
Shares of Polaris were off 1/4 to 29-1/2.
